description: This file defines the 'PlaceholderFunctionSignatureInvalidException' class, a specialized exception indicating that a function signature failed validation. It includes methods for constructing the exception, deserialization from JSON, and managing exception details like headers, message, description, and cause.

classes.name: PlaceholderFunctionSignatureInvalidException
classes.description: An immutable, JSON-parsable exception class indicating an invalid function signature, extending DittoRuntimeException and implementing PlaceholderException.

classes.name: PlaceholderFunctionSignatureInvalidException.Builder
classes.description: A nested mutable builder class for constructing instances of PlaceholderFunctionSignatureInvalidException with method chaining.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a builder for this exception with a default message based on invoked parameters and function data.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Deserializes the exception from a JSON object along with headers.

methods.name: toBuilder
methods.description: Returns a mutable builder pre-populated with the current exception's data.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new exception instance with updated headers.
